beats.say: 438 days: Lord of the Rings filmed all three movies in New Zealand simultaneously.
That massive stretch of continuous filming time is longer than a full calendar year.
Director Peter Jackson started principal photography on 11 October 1999 and wrapped on 22 December 2000.
The first movie had its premiere at London's Odeon Leicester Square on 10 December 2001.
The second film premiered at the Ziegfeld Theatre in New York City on 5 December 2002.
The third chapter premiered at the Embassy Theatre in Wellington on 1 December 2003.
In 2021, the Library of Congress selected The Fellowship of the Ring for preservation in the United States National Film Registry.

facts: The three films were shot simultaneously in Jackson's native New Zealand from 11 October 1999 until 22 December 2000.
The first film in the series premiered at the Odeon Leicester Square in London on 10 December 2001.
The second film premiered at the Ziegfeld Theatre in New York City on 5 December 2002.
The third film premiered at the Embassy Theatre in Wellington on 1 December 2003.
In 2021, the Library of Congress selected The Fellowship of the Ring for preservation in the United States National Film Registry.
